captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So, I was having a memory,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: of the first story I wrote about my emotions.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the more I read, the more I was back inside my mind.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And my fear kept pulling the fire alarm.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So I imagined myself as the CEO of my mind,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: looking around to see why.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: Fear?

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: What are you looking at?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: The Void.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Huge.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Unmoving.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And its face was pure darkness.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: It's going to hurt me.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: It hasn't moved.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: That's what scares me.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: It's not safe here.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: Nothing is going to hurt you.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: You don't know that.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Out! Everybody out!

captions.speaker: JOY
captions.text: We always come back.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Panic attacks, forcing every emotion out of my mind.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Causing chaos.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Then one day,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: I put my hand on my fear's shoulder.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: You need to stop pulling the fire alarm.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: It's causing turmoil.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: I'm only trying to keep us safe.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: I can't.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: I'm sorry.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: My fear refused.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: Fear,

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: we need to put you in a time-out.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: So I put my fear into a cage.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Please don't leave me with it.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: I told myself it was the responsible thing to do.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And I felt sadness.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the Void stood there, stone-faced,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: its shadow filling half the room.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And then, when I wasn't looking, I had an image in my mind.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Why are you doing this?

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: You're going to hurt me.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: This is a trick.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: This can't be right.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: This doesn't make any sense.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: You're supposed to hurt me.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Why are you just standing there?

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Are you just here to scare me forever?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the Void did not move.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: It stood there.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: This is it.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: My fear thought the Void had had enough of its complaining,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: and would destroy it.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: But then, my fear felt a hand on its shoulder.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And it looked up, into the face of the Void.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And instead of darkness, my fear saw the twinkling of lights.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Like galaxies, and nebulae, and stars of the universe.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: The Void, filled with bits and pieces of meaning.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And for once, my fear wasn't afraid.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: It felt wonder, and amazement.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Why are you showing me this?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the Void stared into the screen of my consciousness.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: My other emotions were looking back.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: They smiled, just for a moment, then went back to helping me.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Then my fear felt the gentle push of the Void.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: The Void stood there,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: with galaxies twinkling in its dark facade.

captions.speaker: CONSCIOUSNESS
captions.text: Fear.

captions.speaker: FEAR
captions.text: Can I help?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: The old cage had rusted, its gate hanging open.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: But that was just a small detail.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Because the scene changed, to my emotions at the console.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: And the Void, standing in the background.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: I could barely see that rusty cage anymore,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: in the back of my mind.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: After that,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: I may have shed a tear or two myself.
